_comment: One record per planned day-segment. 'geometry' is intentionally empty until a real GPS track or OSM way is imported — do not fabricate a line. metrics is an array so multiple sources' numbers can coexist per spec (never pick one as absolute truth).

routes.name: Ovacık → Faralya → Kabak
routes.notes: Route authority per Culture Routes Society is current OSM data, not AllTrails — OSM comparison not yet done. distanceKm/ascentM are from the user's AllTrails-derived plan only.

routes.name: Kabak → Alınca

variants.name: Via Paradise Beach / Cennet Koyu
variants.notes: User's source screenshot shows an AllTrails closure alert for Kabak–Paradise Beach dated 'as of September 2026', citing an active-fire/increased-risk closure and linking ogm.gov.tr. NOT independently confirmed against OGM yet — do not treat as a confirmed red closure until checked directly against the Forestry Directorate. The main Kabak–Alınca route above is treated as the current plan; this variant is flagged, not chosen or discarded.

routes.notes: Marked orange because of the unverified Paradise Beach closure on the alternate variant, and because Alınca's own reference point (places.json) is low-confidence.

routes.name: Yediburunlar → Bel → Patara
routes.notes: Per the spec's own flag: the endpoint and distance for this day conflict with current route structure in other research (e.g. a figure like 17.6 km to a 'Karadere area' endpoint has been mentioned but is NOT yet sourced in this dataset — do not treat that number as confirmed either). Whether the real endpoint is Bel, Gavurağılı, Karadere, or Patara/Gelemiş proper is UNRESOLVED. Both the original plan and the open question are preserved here; nothing has been silently changed.
